notes_for_successor: DESIGN DECIDED. 5 transport modes + 2 spell pairs. M1 Barge (Wet Ledger poled river barge, PRIMARY, 7 of 10 road legs have water: Stormhold-Helstrom, Helstrom-Gideon, Helstrom-Blackrose, Gideon-Soulrest, Soulrest-Blackrose, Blackrose-Lilmoth, Lilmoth-Archon(tideway, HIGH tide only - inverse of the walking gate)). M2 Coastal packet (Lilmoth-Soulrest across the bay, Lilmoth-Archon round the point, Archon-Bloodmarl Isle), weather-gated. M3 Rootway root-tunnel haulage: silt-strider analogue, ALL 10 road legs, 26 adjacent-station hops, daylight only, severable by plot. M4 Tide-poler local punts, hop-tier only, low/falling tide. M5 Root-speaking = guild guide, Xul-Aneekh rank>=3, star centred on Helstrom to 5 deep-root nodes. Thorn is the ONLY dry settlement (Rootway only) - deliberate, declared. Fares: tier bases from RI-PRG05 (hop<=1600m=12g, leg 1600-3500m=45g, through>3500m=90g) x mode mult {barge .8, poler 1.0, rootway 1.0, packet 1.3, rootspeak 2.5} x faction mult. Fares POSTED, not bartered; disposition<30 => poler refuses (CF-C012 'refusable'). Spells: Mark(t2,900g), Recall(t2,900g), Hist Intervention(t1,220g), Imperial Intervention(t1,220g).
